the_standard: Generate forecast -> Register and seal -> Apply gates -> Render action status -> Grade the sealed forecast regardless of action status. None becomes a blank row.
status: IMPLEMENTED AND WIRED (harness/forecast_contract.py, 25/25 mutants). Independent review not yet run. Our own model has not yet been re-run through it.
why_this_is_a_real_defect_not_a_presenta: On 2026-08-22 this system produced ZERO gradeable rows for six games because their gates fired, and the gates ran BEFORE registration. The consequence is not a sparse card — it is that the model was never scored on those games. A model whose hardest rows silently vanish from its own record accumulates a scorebook made only of the games it felt confident about, and every summary statistic computed from it is conditioned on the model's own confidence. That is unfalsifiable by construction.

design.two_statuses: forecast_status answers 'was a forecast produced'; action_status answers 'may anything be done about it'. FORECAST_STATUSES has exactly one member, so there is no value that means 'suppressed'.
design.sealing: gates run against a SEALED forecast whose hash deliberately EXCLUDES action_status. A gate may render an action status and nothing else; assert_only_action_changed names any sealed field a gate touched.
design.no_blank_rows: validate_card fails when a SCHEDULED game emits no row at all, when a row appears for an unscheduled game, and when one game appears twice.

deterministic_sha256.note: byte-identical stdout including the trailing newline

self_test_claim.detail: MLB 15 + WNBA 4 + NFL 1; every row carries a winner probability, a total forecast, and (WNBA/NFL) an ATS forecast; seed 20260823; 100,000 trials

independent_verification_of_the_owner_ar.forecast_status_uniformity: all 20 rows FORECAST_REGISTERED; action_status takes six distinct values including five blocked ones. The separation holds.

market_not_a_predictive_input.how: grepped the source: market lines appear only as total_line and market_home_spread, i.e. the line an estimand is SCORED AGAINST, never inside a winner probability. The declaration market_data_used_as_predictive_input=false is mechanically true.

one_gap_worth_naming: The binding standard requires 'information class and resolved-information dose' on every row. The reference card carries a model_class but no NUMERIC dose. That is fair for a reference baseline, and it is a field our model must emit — information_class.py already computes starter_information_fraction, so the value exists and only needs threading through.
the_nfl_selection: TEN ML -170 at 0.5u is classified INFORMATION_ADJUSTED_PRESEASON_BASELINE with trained_model_output=false, and its stated basis is announced rotation information, not the price. Under the 2026-07-25 precedent this is OWNER DISCRETION: it is walled from model output, does not touch the model ledger, and is not counted in any model evaluation. Recorded as such.
what_this_does_not_do: It does not re-run our own model. The 8/23 card has not been produced through this contract yet.
It changes no registered forecast, grade or ledger row.
Nothing is promoted. Gate 0/100 NO_PROMOTE, ledger $0, execution UNAUTHORIZED, wager NO.
